assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the attached compact green d20 UI marker. Make a faithful replacement of THIS exact icon, preserving the single emerald green d20, its frontal geometric silhouette and 3-4 flat cel-shaded planes, centered ivory upward arrow, square composition and approximately 5% transparent margin. The required correction: replace ALL burgundy/maroon/plum outlines, including the outer perimeter and ALL internal triangular facet edges, with a uniform COOL NEUTRAL CHARCOAL / BLUE-GRAY outline, approximately #202B35. No red, magenta, purple, brown or warm-colored ink anywhere in the contour. Keep the contour clean and moderately thick so it is readable at 28-32 pixels. Preserve strong clean green fill and solid ivory UP arrow. No numbers, letters, extra dice, glow, external shadow, framing tile, decoration or backdrop. Genuine fully TRANSPARENT background. Entire die visible. Minimal crisp polished flat fantasy game UI icon.
